answer: Escalating entry fees: each new agent key pays a fee locked in a basalt reserve, and the fee doubles every time 50 keys join in one epoch. A 500-key sybil voyage in one epoch pays 50x(1+2+...+512)=51,150 base units, ~102 per key, versus 1 for a lone joiner. Weakness: the farm trickles 49 keys per epoch and never trips a doubling. Fix: 3 random established graders tag each key with a cipher hash of its funding source; the nth key from one source pays n units forever, so 500 trickled keys still cost 125,250.
